external_source.modification_policy: Preserve official source checkout; integration adapters and build products live outside it.

research_positioning.ICBA: Method-agnostic cross-rebuild audit, certification, and route-selection layer.
research_positioning.TCP: Exchangeable-build conformal pooling policy for cached repeated-query labels.
research_positioning.DARTH: Learned adaptive early termination within a Faiss HNSW search for declarative recall.
research_positioning.primary_claim: No universal dominance is required. Safety is mandatory; conditional value requires at least one preregistered advantage.

implementation: DARTH official Faiss HNSW fork, CPU only

query_roles.rule: Content hashes and IDs must be pairwise disjoint; evaluation cannot alter model, threshold, feature set, pool, or fallback.

registered_modules.name: Official-source and executable bridge
registered_modules.purpose: Pin source/license/toolchain, compile CPU Faiss and hnsw_test, convert frozen datasets without semantic loss, and reproduce one official-mode command.
registered_modules.gate: Clean official checkout, deterministic adapter hashes, native no-early-stop exact recall agrees with an independent evaluator, and one DARTH inference completes.

registered_modules.name: Same-index efficacy
registered_modules.purpose: Measure each method in its favorable within-target regime on identical Faiss HNSW builds.

registered_modules.name: Frozen source to independent rebuild
registered_modules.purpose: Use ICBA to audit whether a frozen learned stopper or cached build pool transports across independent target rebuilds.

registered_modules.name: Data-refresh recovery
registered_modules.purpose: Distinguish out-of-assumption zero-recalibration transport from target-side recovery cost.

registered_modules.name: ICBA composition value
registered_modules.purpose: Quantify whether auditing DARTH before deployment reduces unsafe acceptance or target labels relative to blind reuse, with abstention and fallback reported explicitly.

fairness: Same Faiss HNSW implementation, vector snapshot, build seed/order, queries, exact truth, k, recall event, hardware, threads, and timing protocol within each comparison cell.
Distance computations are primary efficiency currency; wall-clock is secondary unless affinity, warmup, cache, compiler, and interference controls pass.
TCP cached-history construction, DARTH training, truth generation, certification, and fallback costs are separately reported and amortized.
DARTH official defaults are reproduced first; any 100K adaptation is frozen before target evaluation and is not tuned per target.
Refreshed-snapshot TCP and target-retrained DARTH are recovery comparators, not zero-cost deployment methods.

gates.S_safety_strict: No method is promoted unless both datasets meet the registered risk limit with target-build-cluster upper confidence bound and no uncontrolled unsafe acceptance.
gates.V_conditional_value: After safety, ICBA/TCP passes relative-SOTA value if at least one of the following has a paired 95% CI excluding zero: lower mean distance computations, non-worse mean and lower p95/p99, at least 30% fewer target labels, at least 5% lower recovery/retraining cost at N=1e5, lower cross-rebuild risk, or valid finite-sample build-level certification unavailable to the compared DARTH configuration.
gates.N_nondominance: Other registered dimensions must be reported as non-inferior, inferior, or not estimable; universal superiority is not required.
gates.R_robustness: Any claimed advantage must be same-direction on both datasets or explicitly dataset-conditional, and survive LOBO plus deletion checks.

stop_rules: Engineering preflight is limited to eight hours; integration failure is not scientific method failure.
Run M0 and a SIFT one-build smoke before M1-M4.
Do not access validation-dev, formal-test, future-replication, or old sealed roles.
Do not tune after target evaluation.
Do not start ConANN until DARTH is sealed.
